findings.claim: 2026-01-29 Modine 與 Gentherm 簽約，以 Reverse Morris Trust 合併 Performance Technologies 事業；Modine 收 2.1 億美元現金，股東持有合併後 Gentherm 約 40%。
findings.excerpt: the Company's Performance Technologies business (the "Performance Technologies Business") will be combined with Gentherm in a Reverse Morris Trust transaction. As a result of the transaction, the Company will receive $210 million in cash, subject to adjustment as described below, and the Company's shareholders will own approximately 40% of the outstanding Gentherm common stock following the transaction

findings.claim: 2026-10-01 交易完成：Modine 處分 Performance Technologies 部門，收到現金分配，股東取得 Gentherm 股票。
findings.excerpt: On the Closing Date, the Company completed the disposition of the Performance Technologies Business, which constituted the Company's Performance Technologies reportable segment, through the Separation, the Distribution and the Merger.

findings.claim: CPSC 於 2026-08-20 公告 Modine 旗下 Airedale ClassMate／SchoolMate 熱泵通風風扇因火災風險自願召回，美國約 6,061 台、加拿大約 735 台，11 起起火、財損至少 270 萬美元，無傷亡。
10-K（FY2026）：其他訴訟預期不致對財務狀況造成重大不利影響；搜尋未見證券集體訴訟或 SEC 調查。
findings.excerpt: The Company believes that any additional loss in excess of amounts already accrued would not have a material effect on the Company's consolidated balance sheet, results of operations, and cash flows.

note: 未查到證券集體訴訟、SEC 調查或重編；Levi & Korsinsky 調查通知日期不明，未採用。
